frame: x right (facing the dock's front), y depth toward the user (0 = back edge), z up (0 = desk); origin back-left-bottom; boxes on the nominal 8 mm grid (real parts 0.1 mm smaller/side); studs (dia 4.8, 1.7 tall) on top of every non-tile part (slopes: only on the high row; jumper 15573: one stud at its centre); slope parts have 'slope' {down: fall direction, high_mm: width of the flat high row, lip_mm}

steps.1: Base: plates over the whole 16 x 35 footprint (this is what stands on the desk).
steps.2: Second plate layer; its seams cross the first. The smooth Tile 2 x 3 in the pocket is the PLUG SEAT.
steps.3: Plate layer with the plug pocket (2 x 3 studs) and the cable channel to the back edge. The 2 x 3 studs of plate left in the channel right behind the pocket are the boot SADDLE.
steps.4: Brick course round the pocket and the cable channel (16 x 12.8 mm, straight out of the back).
steps.5: Fit the plug: felt + paper shim on the seat, foam pads in the pocket, head in tip up, boot on the saddle with foam above and below it, cable out of the back. (No LEGO parts in this step.)
steps.6: The floor: FIRST the 1 x 4 roof tiles over the channel (they hold the plug down), then the jumper plates under the left and back walls, the slot floor tiles, the plates under the right wall and the plinth tiles.
steps.7: Wall plates. The left and back walls go half a stud over, on the jumpers' centre studs.
steps.8: Wall courses 1-3. Left wall: Dark Red outer panel; right and back walls Dark Bluish Gray.
steps.9: Wall courses 4-6; the front steps get their 33 deg slopes and 45 deg lead-in slopes.
steps.11: Wall courses 10-12: the tall rear section and the back wall's slope crest.
steps.12: Liners and plug setting: felt on the floor and the right wall, felt on the left wall (14" only), back liner; then the seating test. (No LEGO parts in this step.)

reference.name: MacBook Pro 16" (M3/M4/M5) (closed, on its left side)
USB4 cable (OD 4.8) to the dock box

EVA under the boot (on the saddle)
